subject: One-off onboarding credits for Brightside pilot
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@brightside.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: one-off onboarding credits for Brightside pilot

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency and cost profiles. We're kicking off a 6-week pilot this week and ran into a snag with the self-serve credit flow: our trial seats used the initial credits and the automated top-up apparently didn't trigger.

Can Redwood issue a one-off promo code for 50k tokens (team-level) that we can redeem for the pilot? We need the code to expire in 45 days and to be single-use for our org (so we can track redemption). If possible, include a note that the code cannot be stacked with other promos and that tokens will be consumed from the PLG credit bucket.

I attached a short onboarding plan and an outline of pilot success metrics. Happy to provide the HubSpot deal id if helpful.

Appreciate the quick help — the engineers are blocked on a couple of feature tests without these tokens.

Best,
Elaine
Brightside.ai

Attachments: onboarding_plan.pdf (7 KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@brightside.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-10T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-off onboarding credits for Brightside pilot

Hi Elaine — thanks for sending the plan and for the heads up.

Quick answers: we can do a one-off promo code for the pilot. Need to confirm a couple of things before I generate the code:
- Final token amount you want us to credit for the org (you proposed 50k tokens; confirm if that's total or per-seat)
- Desired expiry date (you asked for ~45 days; please confirm exact date)
- HubSpot deal id so I can attach the issuance to the record for finance/audit

Neha — can you confirm if a 50k token one-off is within our delegated approval limits from the PLG ops bucket, and whether we should route this through the promo engine (single-use org-scoped code) or issue a consumption grant on the billing account?

Elaine — once Neha confirms, I will generate the code and send redemption instructions.

Ben
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199

Onboarding plan attached: onboarding_plan.pdf

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-10T15:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-off onboarding credits for Brightside pilot

Ben — verified with PLG ops. We can approve a one-off 50,000-token promo from the PLG credit pool for Brightside.ai. A couple operational notes:

- Approval: within delegated approval (no leadership escalation needed)
- Code type: single-use promo code scoped to the org (recommended for tracking)
- Expiry: please set expiry to 2026-06-24 (45 days from issue)
- Accounting: attach HS deal RDW-2026-4591 to the issuance record and flag as "pilot grant" for month-end reconciliation

Dev — please generate the single-use promo code with the above parameters and post the code to this thread. Include the redemption link and any limits (non-stackable; token bucket applies). Also add a note about how we will reconcile unused tokens after the pilot (auto-expire vs manual reclaim).

Thanks,
Neha
Sales Ops | Redwood Inference

Onboarding checklist: confirm code generated, share redemption steps with customer, attach code to HubSpot deal.

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@brightside.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-11T14:36:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: one-off onboarding credits for Brightside pilot

Hi Elaine — attaching the promo code for your pilot. Please follow the redemption steps below; reply once you've redeemed so we can confirm tokens landed in your account.

=== PROMO CODE ===
Code: BRIGHT-ONRAMP-50K-2026
Amount: 50,000 tokens
Scope: single-use, organization-scoped (Brightside.ai)
Expiry: 2026-06-24T23:59:00Z
Notes: Non-stackable with other promotional credits. Tokens will draw from the PLG credit bucket and be tracked on HubSpot deal RDW-2026-4591. Unused tokens will expire and are not refundable; if you expect < 50k consumption we can reissue a smaller code in a follow-up.

Redemption steps:
1) Sign in to your Brightside admin account at https://console.redwood.com/login
2) Navigate to Billing > Promo Codes > Redeem
3) Paste the code and confirm. You should see the credit appear under "PLG trial credits" within 1 minute.

If you run into any errors during redemption please reply with a screenshot.

Best of luck with the pilot — ping me if we should extend the expiry or issue additional top-ups mid-pilot.

Cheers,
Dev Patel
Platform Ops | Redwood Inference

Attachments: promo_code.txt (contains code and issuance metadata)
